reason: I already order through a company I know and it mostly works fine, so why would I hand my money up front to a name I've never heard of? Their fees aren't obviously cheaper than what I pay now, and for my shop a bad order is real lost money.
objection: Paying the item price in advance to a brand-new company with no track record. If they disappear or the goods are fake, who do I chase?
would_change_my_mind: Letting me pay everything on delivery for my first order, or a trader I know in Shorja vouching that they've used them for months without problems.
